scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Nadia sits with her ankle on pillows directing Thibault's bread kneading and Claire's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Antoine chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Thibault and Nadia tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Claire, Odette, and Henri lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Etienne nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Claire and Henri convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Odette to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Odette's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Nadia, Antoine, and Thibault clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Etienne, Claire, and Odette learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Etienne's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
